data.caption:
Diwali offers khatam aur smartphones par bada jhatka! 📱💸

• Samsung aur Redmi ke 41 models mehange ho gaye hain
• Keematon mein ₹4,000 tak ki badhotari hui hai
• Tyohar ke baad phone lene walon ki jeb par seedha asar

Ab naye phone ka sapna chhod kar purane par naya cover hi chadha lo dosto.

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo naya phone lene ki planning kar raha tha! 👇
